name: Taldy Caves
full: Taldy (Tavda) Caves — a karst massif on the left bank of the Katun opposite the settlement of Izvestkovy (Altai Republic), in the Biryuzovaya Katun (Turquoise Katun) resort zone
near: Izvestkovy settlement (Maima District of the Altai Republic, on the Chuysky Trakt, right bank, ≈2.3 km to the south); Aya village and the Biryuzovaya Katun resort zone (Altai Krai)
elev: entrances 40–200 m above the Katun; the viewing platform ≈100 m above the river; the Arch of Wishes 80 m above the river (absolute elevation not found)
short: About 30 karst caves in limestone cliffs above the Katun: the developed Big Taldy Cave, 1,107 steps, viewing platforms and an arch — the most visited cave site near Gorno-Altaysk.
desc: The Taldy, or Tavda, caves are a complex of about 30 caves in Cambrian limestones of the Taldy karst massif, stretching ≈5 km along the left bank of the Katun. The name “Tavda” is linked with the word “tavda” (high bank), and “Taldy” with “tal” (willow). The site is a natural monument of regional significance in Altai Krai (per the Great Russian Encyclopedia it was declared in 2010, area 360 ha; by other data it has been protected since 1998), and is part of the tourist-recreation special economic zone Biryuzovaya Katun. The main one is Big Taldy (Tavda, “Maiden's Tears”): the main gallery is ≈140 m, the total length of passages ≈270 m, with electric lighting and stairs; nearby are Tavda-2 (≈250 m), Bear's Den and others. Excavations found traces of Bronze Age and early Iron Age camps; in the early 19th century Old Believer hermits lived here, and later people searched for “Kolchak's gold”. Visits are organized by the “Crossroads of Worlds” archaeological park: the main excursion “Taldy Caves” is 1.2 km, ≈1.5 h, 1,107 steps, a viewing platform 100 m above the Katun, the “Dragon's Nostrils” and the Arch of Wishes; there are also “Exciting Speleology” (4 h), the “Robinson Trail”, the “Ancestors' Trail” and “Place of Power”. Independent exploration of the caves is not allowed — groups with a guide.
guide: This is not Ongudai and not even the Altai Republic: the caves stand on the left, “krai” bank of the Katun, 40 km from Gorno-Altaysk — easy to fit into the first day of a trip. Be ready for 1,107 steps — the climb is brisk, but from the viewing platform the whole Katun valley opens up. Find the “Dragon's Nostrils” and make a wish at the Arch — nature and legend hung it 80 m above the river. Bring a flashlight and a jacket: it is cool in the cave and in places you will have to stoop. In rain the caves may be closed — then guides lead you along the “Ancestors' Trail”.
see: Big Taldy Cave with its lighting; the viewing platform 100 m above the Katun; the “Dragon's Nostrils”; the Arch of Wishes (a natural monument); Tavda-2 and Bear's Den (on the speleology route); an ancient human campsite; the Roerich monument; nearby — the Kamyshla Waterfall and the artificial lake of Biryuzovaya Katun.
skip: Stairs are hard for you (1,107 steps) or you are traveling with a child under 7 — according to KP, small children are not taken on the route. If you want “wild” Altai without crowds — in summer this is a conveyor of groups.
diff: Moderate: 1.2 km and 1,107 steps, stooping in places; the speleology route is hard (4 h, climbing)
when: May–September; season: May — the beginning, July–August — the peak (queues of groups), September — a decline (Yandex reviews). Visits only in dry weather.
hours: Daily 10:00–18:00 (KP, gorniy-altai.ru); in winter check with “Crossroads of Worlds” (+7 905 925-10-11)
daytime: Morning — fewer groups and cooler on the stairs (editorial)
how: By car: along the Chuysky Trakt from Gorno-Altaysk to Souzga, after it turn right onto the free bridge over the Katun at Aya, then ≈15–20 km along the Aya Trakt through Biryuzovaya Katun; the entrance is 200–250 m beyond the artificial lake on the right. Entry to Biryuzovaya Katun has been free since 2018. On foot/by public transport: by bus from Gorno-Altaysk to Izvestkovy (the buses to Chemal go along the trakt) and across the Katun by the bridge at the Arzhan-Suu spring (≈1 km to the caves; driving a car over this bridge is paid — 150–350 ₽ according to different reviews).
needcar: Desirable (car/taxi/excursion); you can take a bus to Izvestkovy + walk across the bridge
self: Getting there — yes; inside the caves — only as part of a group with a “Crossroads of Worlds” guide (per Yandex reviews of 2025–2026: a self-guided 40–45 min format is also sold)
roadtype: Paved to the entrance (Aya Trakt / Biryuzovaya Katun); on the route — wooden stairs and trails
traveltime: ≈40–60 min from Gorno-Altaysk by car; ≈3.5–4 h from Barnaul
stay: Hotels and tourist bases of Biryuzovaya Katun: Domina Altai Shambhala (next to the caves, spa, pool), Altai Palace “Maralnik”, Grand Chalet Altay, “Podgoritsa” (economy, 3 km), “SrediGor”, “Kedrovy Bereg”, “Dom Katun” (per sibalt.ru, prices not found)
net: not found (a resort zone near Gorno-Altaysk — coverage is expected but not confirmed)
entry: Excursion “Taldy Caves”: 600 ₽ adult, 300 ₽ child (Yandex reviews, July 2026); 1,300 ₽ for 3 tickets — adult, child, pensioner (June 2026); independently 500 ₽ (September 2025). Earlier: 200/100 ₽ (2022); 900 ₽/person as part of a private tour (putevka). There is no resort fee.
transfer: Private excursions from Gorno-Altaysk 29,400–35,000 ₽ per group (2025–2026); taxi — not found
bring: Comfortable shoes with good tread, a jacket/sweater (it is cool in the cave), a flashlight, water; for children — spare clothes
warn: The site is in Altai Krai, not in the Altai Republic (the krai's rules and the SEZ rules apply on this bank). Visit the caves only in dry weather; 1,107 steps are hard for people with heart conditions and limited mobility; dogs are not allowed into the caves (there are kennels); per KP, children under 7 are not admitted. Ticks in spring — early summer. Do not stray from the group and don't climb into unlit passages. The fee for driving over the bridge at Arzhan-Suu is 350 ₽ (Yandex review, 2026).
food: Cafes and souvenir stalls at the entrance and in Biryuzovaya Katun; mountain honey from apiaries (included in some excursions)
reviews: Yandex Maps: 5.0 (8,186 ratings, 2,711 reviews, 2026); 2GIS: “Tavda Caves” 4.9 (1,539 ratings). Pluses: views of the Katun, fun guides, a widened tunnel. Minuses: many steps, mandatory groups, no dogs, summer crowds.
p.sum: A paid excursion site in the Biryuzovaya Katun resort zone (Altai Krai), 40 km from Gorno-Altaysk; the main excursion is 1.2 km / 1.5 h / 1,107 steps. It is not connected with Ongudai or the Karakol Valley.
